title: The Pula Code of Corporate Governance
citation: Botswana Accountancy Oversight Authority, The Pula Code of Corporate Governance, issued under Financial Reporting Act 2010 s. 6(1)(f) and Financial Reporting Regulations 2021 reg. 19
evidence: The code does not state its own commencement date. It says "The Pula Code of Corporate Governance therefore gets its legitimacy from the following Sections of the Act: Section 6 (1) f and g" and "This Act makes the Pula Code of Corporate Governance a legal requirement for all eligible PIEs"; it states the Financial Reporting (Amendment) Act, 2020 "became effective on 1st April 2022". Opened https://www.baoa.org.bw/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Botswana-Code-of-Corporate-Governance.pdf on 2026-11-05 (PDF metadata creation date 2022-12-07).
notes: Articles 22.1 to 22.3 (Sustainability Reporting and Integrated Reporting) cover sustainability and disclosure. The brief expected a 2022 draft; the text found has no draft marking, so it is stored as the BAOA copy and no other final version was found on baoa.org.bw (the /standard-setting-codes/ page links no PDF to scripts). One record, English only; the record is dated 2022-12-07, the PDF creation date, because no official page states a commencement date. Binding effect is as the code states it (legal requirement for eligible PIEs); BAOA's Financial Reporting Act and Regulations texts were not opened.

title: Environmental Assessment Act, 2011 (Act No. 10 of 2011)
citation: Environmental Assessment Act, 2011 (Act No. 10 of 2011), Government Gazette supplement of 30 June 2011; amended by Act No. 11 of 2020 and S.I. 33 of 2021 per botswanalaws.com
evidence: Not read: www.gov.bw answers curl with an expired certificate and cms2.gov.bw with no connection on 2026-11-05. The Blackhall copy (testelaws.botswanalaws.com) says the Act comes into operation on a date the Minister appoints; no commencement notice was found.
notes: Environmental framework act. No Botswana climate change act or bill was found. Link only: the government PDF could not be opened from the laptop and the only readable copy is Blackhall's (permission requested, BW-BLACKHALL-CONSOLIDATED). Date and amendment state come from a web search result and are unverified.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2018 (Act No. 5 of 2018)
citation: Consumer Protection Act, 2018 (Act No. 5 of 2018), Gazette supplement pages A.227 onward
evidence: The Act in the CCA PDF: "Date of Assent: 27/03/2018", "Date of Commencement: ON NOTICE", and section 1: "shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may, by Order published in the Gazette, appoint". Opened the PDF linked from https://www.cca.co.bw/consumer-protection-act-2018 on 2026-11-05. The brief cites S.I. 155 of 2019 for commencement; no official page that states it was opened.
notes: Section 5 (Prohibition of false or misleading representations) is the umbrella for environmental claims; the Competition and Consumer Authority administers it. The record sits at the assent date 2018-03-27 because no official page states the commencement date. Enacted in English only (Setswana is the national language, not a language of legislation). One record; the CCA copy is the Act as first printed, with no consolidated version on the site.
